source_full: he could wield the sword with the greatest of ease, and felt himself strong enough to do anything, even to fight the giants he had left outside, Who were no doubt wondering why he had not opened the gate to them before this time. To kill the giants, he thought, would be using the sword for the right but as to winning the love of the princess, That was a thing which the son of a poor sheep-farmer need not hope for.
target_full: 他挥动宝剑毫不费力，感觉自己强大到足以做任何事，甚至可以去对抗他留在外面的巨人，那些巨人此刻想必正奇怪他为何到现在还没有为他们打开大门。他心想，杀死巨人，是正确地使用这把剑；但要赢得公主的爱，却是那个贫穷牧羊人之子根本不敢奢望的事。
